_comment: TEST-EXEC: durable manifest after optional test-exec pipeline. Instance: epics/<EPIC-KEY>/<EPIC-KEY>-test-exec.json. Pair with generated specs under epics/<KEY>/tests/*.spec.ts. Do not reference epics/<KEY>/temp/ in durable JSON. Input: <KEY>-tests.json (TEST-PREP). See .cursor/pipelines/test-exec.md.

sources.note: tests_loaded true after successful read; schema_version on -tests.json should be >= 2 for automation hints (optional).

environment.note: Flags are observational only; no secrets, cookies, or connection strings. base_url/build_id only if user supplied in trigger or session.

trigger_options.note: Echo parsed optional tokens from TEST-EXEC: line for audit; null max_bundles means no cap.

_bundles_item.status: skipped_env | skipped_map_only | blocked | skipped_feasibility | generated | passed | failed_clear | failed_ambiguous | skipped_empty_draft
_bundles_item.blocked_reason: requires_console | requires_webbroker | missing_operational_detail | not_ui_db_only | other | null
_bundles_item._spec_path_note: Path relative to epics/<KEY>/; no leading temp/.

_skip_reason_note: e.g. environment_not_ready when base_url missing or MCP probes false; distinct from per-bundle failed_*.
